I’m checking how size reaches download metadata and how metric schemas are declared before wiring the new labels.

item.text: The standard queue path has `meta.size` (sometimes learned on initialization), and preview already has `link.size`. Retry state is the queue’s cumulative `retries` count. I’ll add a typed counter to the metrics package, select the mechanism from size plus service worker support, and report these fields alongside the existing metrics.

The metric is now registered in `@proton/metrics`, and the hook emits status, retry, and mechanism on the same terminal states as the current success metric. Stateful downloads use `meta.size`; preview reports pass `link.size`. I’ve added a focused hook assertion for a retry using memory. Next I’m running the existing relevant test and checking types/diff for integration issues.
